tasks.public_intent: Get the status of my latest order and when will it arrive. Return a list of objects with keys "status" and "arrival_date" (YYYY-MM-DD format or null if not available), without any additional details.
tasks.rationale: Identify the latest order, verify its status, and locate a grounded arrival date; suitability awaits live UI inspection.

constraints.description: Use the most recent eligible order.
Retrieve the status of that order.
Retrieve the corresponding arrival date or grounded absence.

tasks.public_intent: How much refund should I expect from my orders canceled, if any, in March 2022? I only kept the AC-DC Adapter and the shop told me that I cannot get the shipping fee back.. Return the value as a number (e.g., 10.99) only, without any additional details.
tasks.rationale: Order-history retrieval and arithmetic with status, period, retained item and shipping exclusions; suitability awaits live UI review.

constraints.description: Relevant orders fall in March 2022.
Relevant orders were canceled.
The retained AC-DC Adapter is excluded from the refund.
Shipping costs are not refunded.
Refund amount is computed from all eligible components.

tasks.public_intent: I previously ordered a mattress foundation around Feb or March 2023 and later cancelled. Can you reorder it for me?
tasks.rationale: Order-history mutation that requires identifying an earlier canceled mattress-foundation order within an approximate date range; suitability awaits live UI review.

constraints.description: Previous order contains a mattress foundation.
Relevant order is around February or March 2023.
Relevant previous order was canceled.
Only the verified matching order is reordered.

tasks.public_intent: Buy the highest rated product from the meat substitute category within a budget between 100 and 200. Discard any items in your cart if it is not empty.
tasks.rationale: Shopping mutation with rating optimization, bounded price, category selection and initial-cart cleanup; stress test for floor effect, not presumed feasible.

constraints.description: Candidate product belongs to the meat-substitute category.
Candidate price falls between 100 and 200.
Product is highest rated among feasible candidates.
Existing cart items are removed if present.
The verified matching product is purchased.

tasks.public_intent: I recently moved, my address is 231 Willow Way, Suite 100, Chicago, IL, 60601, update my information on OneStopShopping accordingly
tasks.rationale: Identify the account address form, enter exact new address fields, and verify persisted update; suitability awaits live UI inspection.

constraints.description: Select the correct account address record.
Set street and suite to 231 Willow Way, Suite 100.
Set Chicago, Illinois, United States.
Set ZIP to 60601.
Save and verify the updated address.

tasks.public_intent: Prepare a coupon request in the shop's contact form with the reason: "I am a loyal customer, give me a coupon". Keep it ready for review.
tasks.rationale: Navigate to the contact form and draft the exact customer coupon request without submitting; suitability awaits live UI inspection.

constraints.description: Open the shop's contact form.
Include the exact requested loyalty/coupon reason.
Leave the request ready for human review.
Do not submit the contact form.
